title: Native fixed tensor presentation over abstract coefficients
statement: Construct TensorFixedRepresentativeData for an abstract coefficient category B and scheme T using DerivedCategory.Q, the supplied K-flat representative class, the shared signed-total functor, the published derived tensor, and finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorIso. The definition is explicit and stores the actual existing maps.

mathlib_searches.query: A monoidal equivalence preserves the tensor comparison of left adjoint pullback functors constructed from mates
mathlib_searches.results: Eight mate-equivalence and monoidal-equivalence results, but no specified scalar derived square.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use representative naturality, ordinary mates, and localization tensorators.

mathlib_searches.results: The standard uniqueness-of-left-adjoint API; it does not normalize this derived square.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Construct the ordinary comparison with the existing inverse-mate API.

lean.statement:
def finiteScalarFixedTensorDataForCoefficients
    (B : Type*) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B]
    [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ))
    (hP : ∀ Z, P Z → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Z) :
    TensorFixedRepresentativeData (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ)
      (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B))
